messages:
anna_product: Quick sync — we need to recalibrate RICE for the Q4 roadmap. Workshop Thursday 11:00 AM PT to re-score and sequence. TL;DR: two high-priority asks surfaced from sales + infra: private VPC GA vs embedding-latency optimizations + KV/prefix cache. Need to discuss tradeoffs and launch criteria.
kevin_pm: @anna_product Thursday works for me. One question: are customer-conditional deals included in reach scoring or handled separately as 'strategic revenue'?
anna_product: Include them in reach but flag revenue-weighted in a separate column. Sales says 3 deals are contingent on private VPC GA.
devon_metrics: From telemetry: embedding-heavy endpoints show ~18% cost reduction if we enable smarter batching + KV caching. That looks like medium-high impact on unit economics.
maria_eng: Quick engineering callouts: batching + KV cache improvements ~3 sprint-equivalents to implement and stabilize. Private VPC GA including infra, compliance, onboarding ≈ 6-8 sprints.
sanjay_research: Heads-up: aggressive quantization or cache heuristics for embeddings could cause accuracy regressions. We'll need eval guardrails and regression alerts.
claire_design: UX for private onboarding (console + docs + support flows) is non-trivial — estimate ~1 sprint for alpha flow.
kevin_pm: Proposed quick RICE snapshot to discuss in the workshop:
```
Initiative, Reach, Impact (1-10), Confidence (0-100), Effort (sprints)
Private VPC GA, 30, 8, 60, 7
Embedding latency + cache, 200, 6, 70, 3
Billing & cost transparency, 150, 4, 80, 2
```
anna_product: Let's compute RICE = (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort. Can someone run the numbers so we have a baseline?
devon_metrics: Quick calc: 
- Private VPC GA: (30 * 8 * 0.6) / 7 = ~20.6
- Embedding optim: (200 * 6 * 0.7) / 3 = 280
- Billing: (150 * 4 * 0.8) / 2 = 240
maria_eng: Those raw scores strongly favor embedding work. But pragmatic note: we can't ignore enterprise deals — VPC GA is high-dollar and strategic, even if reach is low.
kevin_pm: Agreed. Suggestion: prioritize embedding perf as an MVP in Q4 (fast win, reduces unit cost) and run VPC as a multi-quarter epic with a sales-facing alpha milestone.
anna_product: Proposal for the workshop: ship embedding optim + cache improvements as Q4 milestone (MVP), kick off VPC infra work as a parallel epic limited-scope alpha for 1-2 customers. Also set gating criteria for VPC GA.
sanjay_research: For embedding changes, add an eval gate: no more than 2% relative degradation on the standard embedding benchmark set. If regression >2%, block rollout.
claire_design: :thumbsup: I'll scope alpha onboarding flows + minimal console screens this sprint.
devon_metrics: I'll prepare dashboards to track cost-per-query delta, latency P95/P99, and an A/B experiment plan for the rollout.
kevin_pm: I'll draft a condensed PRD for the embedding milestone and an adjusted RICE that adds a revenue-weighted column for the VPC deals (so execs can see ARR impact). Draft by EOD.
anna_product: Action items: 
- @kevin_pm: PRD + adjusted RICE by EOD
- @maria_eng: engineering plan + resource ask
- @claire_design: alpha onboarding mockups
- @devon_metrics: KPIs & dashboard
- @sanjay_research: eval gating criteria
I'll run a follow-up on Friday with the updated scores. Thanks all.
opsbot: Reminder: Roadmap reprior workshop Thu 11:00 AM PT — calendar invite sent.
